en.name: Pig blood cake
en.summary: Cooked pig blood cake keeps 3–4 days in the refrigerator at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, and 2–3 months in the freezer at −18 °C (0 °F). It is cooked blood and cooked glutinous rice in one block — two of the most perishable things in a Taiwanese kitchen.
en.pantry: A blood cake left on a counter or sitting in a warm steamer cabinet all afternoon is precisely the hazard to avoid. Bacillus cereus spores survive normal cooking temperatures, and the heat of cooking actually activates their germination; poisoning from its toxin is generally associated with rice products and other starchy foods, which is exactly what this is. Food that is not eaten immediately should be held above 60 °C or at 4 °C (40 °F) or below — not in between. Get it into the fridge within two hours, or one hour above 32 °C (90 °F).
en.fridge: 3–4 days at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, wrapped or in a covered container so the surface does not dry and crack. Take those days as the timeline for cooked meat leftovers applied to this dish — no separate published figure exists for 豬血糕. Reheat only the portion you will eat, by steaming until it is hot right through; a blood cake reheated only on the outside, which is very easy to do with something this dense, is the failure to watch for.
en.freezer: 2–3 months at −18 °C (0 °F). Cut it into portions before freezing, wrap each piece and press the air out of the bag. Steam it from frozen rather than thawing it on the counter — a dense block thaws unevenly and spends too long warm on the outside while the middle is still cold. The texture holds up well to freezing; if anything the cake becomes slightly firmer and takes a skewer better afterwards.
en.thawing: Steam it straight from frozen, or thaw it in the fridge if you need it soft first. Never thaw it on the counter, and always reheat until hot right through.
spoilage: A sour or fermented smell rather than the usual faintly metallic, rice-scented one.
A slimy or sticky film on the surface.
Grey-green or iridescent patches, or a surface that has gone tacky.
Any mould, or liquid pooling in the container and smelling sharp.
tips: Cut into portions before chilling or freezing so each piece cools and reheats evenly.
Steam from frozen rather than thawing on the counter.
Hold it above 60 °C or at 4 °C or below — never lukewarm in a cabinet.
Reheat only what you will eat, and make sure the centre is hot.

faq.q: How long does pig blood cake keep?
faq.a: 3–4 days in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, or 2–3 months frozen at −18 °C (0 °F).

faq.q: Can you freeze pig blood cake?
faq.a: Yes, 2–3 months at −18 °C. Cut it into portions first and steam it straight from frozen.

faq.q: Is it safe to leave blood cake in a warm steamer all day?
faq.a: No. Starchy cooked food held lukewarm grows Bacillus cereus, whose spores survive cooking. Hold it above 60 °C or refrigerate at 4 °C or below.

zh.name: 豬血糕
zh.summary: 煮熟的豬血糕冷藏 4 °C 以下可放 3～4 天，冷凍 −18 °C 下 2～3 個月。它把「熟血」和「熟糯米」壓在同一塊裡，那是台灣廚房裡最容易壞的兩樣東西。
zh.pantry: 一塊豬血糕放在檯面上、或整個下午待在溫熱的蒸籠櫃裡，正是要避免的危害。仙人掌桿菌的孢子撐得過一般烹調溫度，而加熱本身還會活化它們萌發；它的毒素造成的中毒，一般都和米製品及其他澱粉類食品有關——而這塊東西正好就是。沒有要立刻吃的食物，應該保持在 60 °C 以上，或 4 °C 以下，不要停在中間。請在兩小時內冰起來，氣溫超過 32 °C 時縮短為一小時。
zh.fridge: 4 °C 以下 3～4 天，包好或裝進加蓋容器，避免表面乾裂。這幾天請理解成「熟肉剩菜」的時間表套用到這道菜上——針對豬血糕本身，並沒有公布過的數字。要吃多少熱多少，用蒸的、蒸到中心熱透；這種密實的東西最容易發生的失敗，就是外面熱了、裡面還是冷的。
zh.freezer: −18 °C 下 2～3 個月。冷凍前先切成一次的份量，每塊包好並把袋內空氣壓出。回熱時直接從冷凍蒸，不要放在檯面上退冰——密實的塊狀解凍不均勻，外層會在中心還冰著的時候溫太久。它的質地相當耐冷凍，甚至會變得略為結實，之後串竹籤更好串。
zh.thawing: 直接從冷凍蒸；需要先變軟的話請放冷藏解凍。不要放室溫退冰，而且每次都要加熱到中心熱透。
spoilage: 聞起來發酸或有發酵味，而不是原本淡淡的金屬味與米香。
表面出現黏滑或發黏的薄膜。
出現灰綠色或虹彩光澤的斑，或表面變得發黏。
長霉，或容器裡積水且氣味刺鼻。
tips: 先切成份量再冷藏或冷凍，每塊才會均勻降溫與回熱。
從冷凍直接蒸，不要在檯面上退冰。
保持在 60 °C 以上或 4 °C 以下，不要溫溫地放在櫃子裡。
要吃多少熱多少，並確認中心是熱的。

faq.a: 冷藏 4 °C 以下 3～4 天，或冷凍 −18 °C 下 2～3 個月。
可以，−18 °C 下 2～3 個月。先切份再冷凍，並直接從冷凍蒸。

faq.q: 放在溫熱的蒸籠裡一整天可以嗎？
faq.a: 不行。溫溫放著的熟澱粉會長仙人掌桿菌，而它的孢子撐得過烹煮。請保持 60 °C 以上或 4 °C 以下冷藏。
